layer_maps.rule: single-object animal image, 15-35% area, IoU>=0.85, 4th best

pipeline.rule: 2 GT classes, both recognised, per-image mIoU in the 70-80th percentile

qualitative.rule: quantiles 95/85/70/55/40/25 of ours per-image mIoU among images with >=2 GT classes

failures.case: Close-up: prior covers only part of the person

coco_examples.rule: quantiles 90/70/50/30 of per-image mIoU, >=3 GT classes

class_gallery.rule: per class: median-IoU object among objects covering 5-60% of the image

layer_examples.rule: per class (dog, car, person, bird): median-IoU object covering 10-50%

oracle_examples.rule: images with oracle gain > 5 pts (n=345), quantiles 90/70/50/30 of the gain

mistral_person.rule: person objects > 30% of frame (n=103), quantiles 90/70/50/30 of Mistral - LLaVA-1.5 person IoU
